change_summary.details: Reduced the east portal surround width and the cap/header projection; pulled the two round support assemblies toward the doorway; moved the inscription with the header. Kept the photo-supported recessed double doors, arched glazed transom, pale stone surround, two slender round supports, stair, landing, and handrails. Dims remain qualitative.

Reproportioned 72 mesh parts without moving their opening centers: first-floor window units target about 2.50 m width, second-floor about 2.70 m, upper band about 2.90 m. This creates closer paired/grouped modules and a stronger upper glazing band based on the CLA photo; those widths are estimates, not measured elevations.

Applied restrained warm brown procedural color and roughness variation to the primary low hipped roof using undated historic PPBUC01117 imagery only. Kept the 0.45 m pale limestone cornice as a thin differentiated eave. Added no new physical roof details; current roof form, material and height remain unverified.

Moved all 47 high roof/dormer/chimney/HVAC option meshes identified in the R4 bound audit to hidden sibling collection SC_Unverified_Architectural_Options_R5, outside Asset_stanley_coulter_hall. Also moved four unsupported copper ridge strips and the unsupported west-entry pediment into that archive: 52 archived meshes total.
Changed the two white-emitting lantern blocks to subdued warm amber material response.

Created a top-down piano-nobile furniture/use schematic with an explicit on-image notice that room locations, partitions and furniture are unverified. Presentation-only; it does not alter room geometry.
